Classify the one canonical repository-relative target as ACTIVE, HISTORICAL_REFERENCE, HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE, or UNCLASSIFIED.
Allow ACTIVE and external HTTP(S); reject all unclassified or historical executable routes unless an exact source/target pair is structured in explicit_provenance_references.
